prompts.label: Part A · 第 47 题
prompts.prompt: Suppose your university is going to host a summer camp for high school students. Write a notice to 1) briefly introduce the camp activities, and 2) call for volunteers. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your name or the name of your university. Do not write your address.

prompts.label: Part B · 第 48 题
prompts.prompt: Write an essay based on the following chart. In your writing, you should 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comment. You should write about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
